# Snapdragon Game Super Resolution 1

`sgsr1_mobile.h` is Qualcomm's Snapdragon GSR 1 shader code, unchanged, from
https://github.com/SnapdragonGameStudios/snapdragon-gsr (`sgsr/v1/include/hlsl`), BSD 3-Clause (`LICENSE.txt`).
It is used by `rt64-ext/src/shaders/GsrPS.hlsl` in Android builds only; Windows builds do not contain it.
